about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover P530 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover P530 is the standard V8 performance tier in the L460 generation (2022–present), using the BMW N63 twin-turbo 4.4-litre V8. This is a different engine from the higher-performance S68 used in the SV/P615 variant — the N63 and S68 are both BMW-sourced V8s but are distinct units with different internal specifications and power outputs. Knowing which one your car has matters because the components, the known wear pattern, and the rebuild specifics differ between them — the N63's hot-vee pattern (valve seals, coolant lines, oil consumption) is well-documented, while the S68 is a later, higher-performance evolution. Land Rover Range Rover P530 Engine Codes BMW N63 (L460) A 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 fitted to the Range Rover P530 from 2022 onward. The N63 hot-vee design has a well-documented pattern across BMW applications — valve seal wear, coolant line degradation and oil consumption are known considerations. We replace timing chains, valve seals and coolant components as standard on every N63 rebuild. Check Your BMW N63 Range Rover P530 → [link to quote form] Land Rover Range Rover P530 Engine Compatibility Because the L460 generation uses two distinct BMW V8s — the N63 (standard performance tier in the P530) and the S68 (performance/flagship tier in the SV/P615) — fitting the wrong replacement, or assuming an N63 part will work on an S68 car, risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover P530 owners, yes. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover P530 from 2023 to present. The BMW N63 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older BMW N63 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every BMW N63 rebuild.
